entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're pretty used to sneakin' in from[n]here now, huh?

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Those intruders the other day were[n]quite entertaining.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: However, I can't allow that trash to[n]ransack my castle!

entries.speaker: Shadow Kamoshida
entries.en: Strengthen the security! Kill them on sight![n]I'll reward whoever brings me their heads.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, Mona. Can't we just beat the crap[n]outta him and call it a day?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look at all those soldiers, idiot! It'd be[n]suicide. And I'm sure you don't want a[n]repeat of last time.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Besides, don't you want him to confess[n]his sins?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no point beating him up. We[n]need to steal his materialized desires...[n]The [clr 2]Treasure[clr 27].

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It has to be somewhere in the depths[n]of this castle.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's infiltrate further in while he's out[n]here!

entries.speaker: Armored Soldier
entries.en: Praise be to King Kamoshida! Death to[n]the intruders!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We can't go in this room right now.[n]Let's check elsewhere.

entries.speaker: Armored Soldier's Voice
entries.en: Praise be to King Kamoshida! Death to[n]the intruders!
